Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic SILAC-based Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry (AP-MS) workflow to identify TSSC4 interactors. Bottom-up mode is confirmed by trypsin digestion of gel bands.

scope: To get insight into a function of TSSC4 in snRNP biogenesis, we first mapped its interaction partners by an unbiased quantitative proteomic approach based on stable isotope labeling in cell culture in conjunction with immunoprecipitation (SILAC IPs).
We tagged TSSC4 with either GFP or FLAG, expressed labeled proteins in HeLa cells, and immunopurified them with anti-GFP or anti-FLAG antibodies, respectively
For SILAC-IP done with GFP tag, extracts were incubated with 50 µL of GFP-Trap beads (Chromotek) while for SILAC-IP with FLAG tag, agarose beads coated with M2 antibodies were used (Sigma).
Bound proteins were eluted by adding 1% SDS to the beads and boiling for 10 min.
